_about: Hand-traced lines the map builder needs that Natural Earth does not have. Points are [lat, lon], about ±2 km. Sources are in docs/HISTORY.md ('The map'). Used only by tools/build-map.mjs, never by the game.

frame._about: 'bounds' [south, west, north, east] is the detailed area round the front (hand-traced towns, roads, railways, villages, contours). 'scenery' is the whole area the map shows: the land beyond 'bounds' is scenery (coast, rivers, borders, big towns), so there's more map to explore. The territories don't depend on it.

front._about: The Western Front as it stood for most of 1915-1917, north (the coast at Nieuport) to south (the Swiss border at Pfetterhouse). The border between every E1 and G1 box follows this line.

laneBreaks._about: Where each lane boundary meets the front line (between lane N and lane N+1), north to south, as [lat, lon] or [lat, lon, tiltEntente, tiltGerman]. The builder snaps each to the nearest front point. A tilt leans that boundary further along the front the deeper it goes (positive = towards the coast), to keep a town in its own lane.

border1871._about: The Franco-German border of 1871-1918 (Germany held Alsace and northern Lorraine), from Luxembourg to Switzerland.

rivers._about: Rivers that Natural Earth 10m does not include, source to mouth.

riverNames._about: Natural Earth river names to draw, and the English label to use.

placeNames._about: Country and sea names drawn on the map. 'at' is [lat, lon].

otherTowns._about: Towns shown only to help you find your way. They are not part of the game. 'at' is [lat, lon].

sceneryTowns._about: Big towns in the scenery beyond 'frame.bounds', to help you find your way (1914 names). Not part of the game. 'at' is [lat, lon].

ridges._about: Crest lines of high ground, [lat, lon], drawn with hillshade and hachures (docs/STYLE.md §4.3). 'width' is how wide the shading is, in map units. Drawing only.

railways._about: Main railway lines of 1914 in the theatre, [lat, lon] through the main stations. Hand-traced (sources in docs/HISTORY.md); not today's network. 'id' lets later rail rules refer to a line. Shown from mid zoom.

roads._about: Main roads that mattered in the war, [lat, lon]. Hand-traced (sources in docs/HISTORY.md). Shown from mid zoom.

villages._about: Villages along the front, shown at full zoom. [lat, lon], about ±1 km. Sources in docs/HISTORY.md.

landmarks._about: Famous places of the war, drawn as small ink symbols at full zoom. 'kind': fort, hill (with 'height' in metres), wood or ridge. [lat, lon]; sources in docs/HISTORY.md.
